snippet.title: Donkey Kong Bananza DLC ‘Super Mario Bros.’ Collaboration – Nintendo Direct 6.9.2026
snippet.description:
In the Donkey Kong Bananza: DK Island & Emerald Rush paid DLC, a limited-time collaboration with Super Mario Bros. is breaking through!

This limited-time collaboration event will be held in four waves with the first wave beginning later today!

#NintendoSwitchOnline #DonkeyKongBananza #NintendoDirect
